question: Find the value of 48−¹⁷ ÷ 48¹² × 48−¹³ .
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the combined exponent rule: am ÷ aⁿ × ap = am − ⁿ ⁺ p

Given expression: 48−¹⁷ ÷ 48¹² × 48−¹³

⇒ Combine the powers since the base (48) is common: −17 − 12 + (−13)

⇒ 48−⁴²

**∴ The correct answer is 48⁻⁴².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression = 48−¹⁷ ÷ 48¹² × 48−¹³

**Formulas Used:**

am ÷ aⁿ = am − ⁿ

am × aⁿ = am ⁺ ⁿ

**Calculation:**

According to BODMAS, multiplication and division have the same priority. We evaluate from left to right.

⇒ (48−¹⁷ ÷ 48¹²) × 48−¹³

⇒ 48⁽−¹⁷ − ¹²⁾ × 48−¹³

⇒ 48−²⁹ × 48−¹³

Now apply the multiplication rule:

⇒ 48⁽−²⁹ ⁺ ⁽−¹³⁾⁾

⇒ 48⁽−²⁹ − ¹³⁾

⇒ 48−⁴²

**∴ The correct answer is 48⁻⁴².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Law of Product and Quotient

When multiplying numbers with the same base, add their exponents: am × aⁿ = am ⁺ ⁿ. When dividing, subtract their exponents: am ÷ aⁿ = am − ⁿ.

Power of a Power Rule

To raise a power to another power, multiply the exponents together: (am)ⁿ = am × ⁿ.

Negative Exponent Rule

A negative exponent means division. Move the term with the negative exponent to the denominator to make it positive: a−ⁿ = 1 ÷ aⁿ.

Zero Exponent Rule

Any non-zero base raised to the power of zero is always equal to 1: a⁰ = 1 (where a ≠ 0).
